findings: Complete original FITS bytes remain unchanged across migration. Manual FITS-card parser verifies header boundaries against PDS4 offsets; 1024x1024 primary/error/quality arrays each contain1048576samples. Primary/error are big-endian float32 DN. Quality stored signed16 with FITS BZERO32768 and PDS4 value_offset32768.
Both images have exactly1048542 offset-applied quality0 and34 quality32 samples. Counts are diagnostics, not independent pixel reliability, coverage, calibration or physical geography.

PDS3 quality descriptions define1 Reed-Solomon error;2 reference calibration-file defect;4 permanent CCD defect;8 saturated pixel;16 missing data;32 other bad pixel. PDS4 definitions instead give1 deltabias defect;2 flatfield defect;4 permanent CCD defect;8 hot pixel;16 saturation;32 missing Level1 data. These are conflicting metadata interpretations for unchanged samples; cause/authoritative product-specific semantics remain open.

No automatic reclassification, masking, interpolation or repair adopted. No claim that flag0 establishes calibrated photometry or that flag32 proves missing telemetry; source definitions retained side by side.

No new angular/raster scale/diameter/terrain/colour computation. Array dimensions and storage indices are file-format diagnostics; no independent target-centroid/PSF/shape or physical registration inferred.
limitations: Manual parser and array cross-check are targeted diagnostics, not full FITS/PDS4 schema conformance validation. Error estimates are publisher products, not independent uncertainty validation.

PDS4 label geometry changes, photometric calibration, bit-definition crosswalk, target pixel identity and raw pipeline history remain open. Migration/publication2026 is not a new observation;2007 exposures preserved.
Both imagined Elara views remain prepared; capacity/native display provenance still needed before additive integration. All earlier dossier/native/model/master/source limitations remain.
